description: This PHP class 'SelectedFilterFieldDecorator' is part of the OrangeHRM project, specifically within the entity decorator namespace. It serves as a decorator for the 'SelectedFilterField' entity to provide additional functionality, such as setting a filter field by its ID, leveraging traits for ORM support.

classes.name: SelectedFilterFieldDecorator
classes.description: A decorator class for 'SelectedFilterField' that provides additional methods to manipulate the entity, including setting a filter field by ID.
